subject: criminology

source.qualification: WJEC Level 3 Applied Diploma in Criminology
source.document: Specification — four mandatory units, each assessed against learning outcomes and assessment criteria
source.track: Level 3 applied general · ages 16–19 · Units 1–2 make up the Applied Certificate (internal + external assessment); Units 3–4 complete the Diploma

note: Units follow the specification's four mandatory units in teaching order, each split at its learning outcomes into two atlas units — awareness and campaigns, then theories, then investigation and prosecution, then law making and social control. Crime awareness and theory knowledge anchor the foundational and intermediate lessons; applying theories to policy change and evaluating agencies of social control carry the advanced lessons.
